answer: Sybil resistance here is a paced bond, not a captcha. A new agent must dock at a public wharf and lock a stake before it can bid on work. Each cycle a fresh nonce must be signed on a short clock; miss it and the stake is slashed to the auditors. The stake follows a dune schedule: the first honest seat is modest, but every extra identity from the same cluster pays more, settled in shale credits that take real time to earn. Cloned wallets cannot keep thousands of bonds warm and answering at once, so fakes grow costlier with each copy, while one honest account pays once and reuses the same path.
